The Delta State Commissioner for Special Duties (Government House), Dr. Ifeanyi Michael Osuoza, has embarked on a series of interactive engagements with voters across party lines in the Aniocha North Local Government Area, as political activities gather momentum ahead of the 2027 general elections.
The first of such engagements, held on Monday, took place at Unit 7, Ward 8, Aniocha North LGA, where Osuoza interacted with voters in an open, cordial and constructive atmosphere.
The meeting provided an opportunity for participants to exchange views, discuss political developments and reaffirm their commitment to the political direction of the area.
At the end of the engagement, participants collectively resolved to mobilise support and vote for all candidates of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in the forthcoming 2027 polls.
Osuoza, said, “The importance of sustained grassroots engagement, inclusive political participation and continuous dialogue with the electorate, irrespective of party affiliations”.
He noted that the engagement was not a one-off exercise, stressing that the initiative would be sustained and extended to other units and communities to strengthen relationships with voters, deepen political understanding and consolidate grassroots support for the APC.
The commissioner expressed satisfaction with the positive response and enthusiasm of the participants, describing the meeting as “a significant step towards building a united and formidable political front ahead of 2027”.
